description: Testing whether FAD-face net charge separates cytochrome b5 reductases from the quinone reductase Pga3, and where Aim33 falls
code:
# Does FAD-face charge discriminate cytochrome b5 reductases from the quinone reductase Pga3?
# Benchmark the metric instead of using it once: superpose AlphaFold models of yeast Cbr1,
# Mcr1, Pga3 and Aim33 onto human CYB5R3 (1UMK) and sum formal charge near the isoalloxazine.
import requests, numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt

AAs = "ARNDCQEGHILKMFPSTWYV"
B62 = """ 4 -1 -2 -2  0 -1 -1  0 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -1  1  0 -3 -2  0
-1  5  0 -2 -3  1  0 -2  0 -3 -2  2 -1 -3 -2 -1 -1 -3 -2 -3
-2  0  6  1 -3  0  0  0  1 -3 -3  0 -2 -3 -2  1  0 -4 -2 -3
-2 -2  1  6 -3  0  2 -1 -1 -3 -4 -1 -3 -3 -1  0 -1 -4 -3 -3
 0 -3 -3 -3  9 -3 -4 -3 -3 -1 -1 -3 -1 -2 -3 -1 -1 -2 -2 -1
-1  1  0  0 -3  5  2 -2  0 -3 -2  1  0 -3 -1  0 -1 -2 -1 -2
-1  0  0  2 -4  2  5 -2  0 -3 -3  1 -2 -3 -1  0 -1 -3 -2 -2
 0 -2  0 -1 -3 -2 -2  6 -2 -4 -4 -2 -3 -3 -2  0 -2 -2 -3 -3
-2  0  1 -1 -3  0  0 -2  8 -3 -3 -1 -2 -1 -2 -1 -2 -2  2 -3
-1 -3 -3 -3 -1 -3 -3 -4 -3  4  2 -3  1  0 -3 -2 -1 -3 -1  3
-1 -2 -3 -4 -1 -2 -3 -4 -3  2  4 -2  2  0 -3 -2 -1 -2 -1  1
-1  2  0 -1 -3  1  1 -2 -1 -3 -2  5 -1 -3 -1  0 -1 -3 -2 -2
-1 -1 -2 -3 -1  0 -2 -3 -2  1  2 -1  5  0 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1  1
-2 -3 -3 -3 -2 -3 -3 -3 -1  0  0 -3  0  6 -4 -2 -2  1  3 -1
-1 -2 -2 -1 -3 -1 -1 -2 -2 -3 -3 -1 -2 -4  7 -1 -1 -4 -3 -2
 1 -1  1  0 -1  0  0  0 -1 -2 -2  0 -1 -2 -1  4  1 -3 -2 -2
 0 -1  0 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -1  1  5 -2 -2  0
-3 -3 -4 -4 -2 -2 -3 -2 -2 -3 -2 -3 -1  1 -4 -3 -2 11  2 -3
-2 -2 -2 -3 -2 -1 -2 -3  2 -1 -1 -2 -1  3 -3 -2 -2  2  7 -1
 0 -3 -3 -3 -1 -2 -2 -3 -3  3  1 -2  1 -1 -2 -2  0 -3 -1  4"""
MM = np.array([[int(x) for x in r.split()] for r in B62.strip().split("\n")], float)
idx = {a: i for i, a in enumerate(AAs)}; GAP = -8.0
THREE = {"ALA":"A","ARG":"R","ASN":"N","ASP":"D","CYS":"C","GLN":"Q","GLU":"E","GLY":"G",
         "HIS":"H","ILE":"I","LEU":"L","LYS":"K","MET":"M","PHE":"F","PRO":"P","SER":"S",
         "THR":"T","TRP":"W","TYR":"Y","VAL":"V"}
def enc(s): return np.array([idx.get(c, -1) for c in s])

def nw_pairs(s1, s2):
    a, b = enc(s1), enc(s2); n, m = len(a), len(b)
    Sub = np.where((a[:,None]>=0)&(b[None,:]>=0), MM[np.clip(a,0,19)[:,None], np.clip(b,0,19)[None,:]], -1.0)
    M_ = np.full((n+1,m+1), -1e9); M_[0,:] = 0.0; M_[:,0] = np.arange(n+1)*GAP
    jj = np.arange(m+1)
    for i in range(1, n+1):
        cand = np.full(m+1, -1e9)
        cand[1:] = np.maximum(M_[i-1,:-1] + Sub[i-1,:], M_[i-1,1:] + GAP); cand[0] = M_[i-1,0] + GAP
        M_[i,:] = np.maximum.accumulate(cand - jj*GAP) + jj*GAP
    i, j = n, int(np.argmax(M_[n,:])); pairs = []
    while i > 0 and j > 0:
        if abs(M_[i,j] - (M_[i-1,j-1] + Sub[i-1,j-1])) < 1e-6: pairs.append((i-1, j-1)); i -= 1; j -= 1
        elif abs(M_[i,j] - (M_[i-1,j] + GAP)) < 1e-6: i -= 1
        else: j -= 1
    return pairs[::-1]

def parse_pdb(txt, chain=None):
    res, het = {}, []
    for ln in txt.split("\n"):
        if ln.startswith("ATOM") and ln[17:20] in THREE:
            ch = ln[21]
            if chain and ch != chain: continue
            key = (ch, int(ln[22:26]))
            res.setdefault(key, {"aa": THREE[ln[17:20]], "atoms": {}})
            res[key]["atoms"][ln[12:16].strip()] = np.array([float(ln[30:38]), float(ln[38:46]), float(ln[46:54])])
        elif ln.startswith("HETATM"):
            het.append((ln[17:20].strip(), ln[12:16].strip(),
                        np.array([float(ln[30:38]), float(ln[38:46]), float(ln[46:54])])))
    keys = sorted(res, key=lambda k: (k[0], k[1]))
    return res, keys, het

def kabsch(Q, P):
    qm, pm = Q.mean(0), P.mean(0); H = (Q-qm).T @ (P-pm)
    U, S, Vt = np.linalg.svd(H); d = np.sign(np.linalg.det(Vt.T @ U.T))
    return Vt.T @ np.diag([1, 1, d]) @ U.T, qm, pm
def apply(V, R, qm, pm): return (V - qm) @ R.T + pm

# reference: human CYB5R3 with FAD
ref_txt = requests.get("https://files.rcsb.org/download/1UMK.pdb", timeout=120).text
rres, rkeys, rhet = parse_pdb(ref_txt, chain="A")
ISO = {"N1","C2","O2","N3","C4","O4","C4X","C4A","N5","C5X","C5A","C6","C7","C7M","C8","C8M","C9","C9A","N10","C10"}
iso = np.array([c for rn, an, c in rhet if rn == "FAD" and an in ISO])
print("1UMK chain A residues:", len(rkeys), " FAD isoalloxazine atoms found:", len(iso))
rseq = "".join(rres[k]["aa"] for k in rkeys)

Q_FORMAL = {"R": 1.0, "K": 1.0, "D": -1.0, "E": -1.0, "H": 0.1}

def face_charge(res, keys, radius):
    tot, n, members = 0.0, 0, []
    for k in keys:
        A = np.array(list(res[k]["atoms"].values()))
        d = np.sqrt(((A[:, None, :] - iso[None, :, :])**2).sum(-1)).min()
        if d <= radius:
            n += 1; q = Q_FORMAL.get(res[k]["aa"], 0.0); tot += q
            if abs(q) >= 0.9: members.append(f"{res[k]['aa']}{k[1]}")
    return tot, n, members

TARGETS = [("hCYB5R3 (1UMK)", None, "cytochrome b5", "experimental"),
           ("Cbr1 yeast",   "P38626", "cytochrome b5", "AlphaFold"),
           ("Mcr1 yeast",   "P36060", "cytochrome b5", "AlphaFold"),
           ("Pga3/Nqr1",    "Q12746", "coenzyme Q6",   "AlphaFold"),
           ("Aim33",        "Q04516", "unknown",       "AlphaFold")]
RADII = [10, 12, 14, 16]
out = []
for nm, ac, acceptor, src in TARGETS:
    if ac is None:
        res, keys, rmsd, npair = rres, rkeys, 0.0, len(rkeys)
    else:
        info = requests.get(f"https://alphafold.ebi.ac.uk/api/prediction/{ac}", timeout=120).json()[0]
        txt = requests.get(info["pdbUrl"], timeout=120).text
        res, keys, _ = parse_pdb(txt)
        qseq = "".join(res[k]["aa"] for k in keys)
        pairs = nw_pairs(qseq, rseq)
        kept = [p for p in pairs if "CA" in res[keys[p[0]]]["atoms"] and "CA" in rres[rkeys[p[1]]]["atoms"]]
        for it in range(12):
            Q = np.array([res[keys[i]]["atoms"]["CA"] for i, j in kept])
            P = np.array([rres[rkeys[j]]["atoms"]["CA"] for i, j in kept])
            R, qm, pm = kabsch(Q, P); d = np.linalg.norm(apply(Q, R, qm, pm) - P, axis=1)
            new = [kept[t] for t in range(len(kept)) if d[t] < 4.0]
            if len(new) < 60 or len(new) == len(kept): break
            kept = new
        Q = np.array([res[keys[i]]["atoms"]["CA"] for i, j in kept])
        P = np.array([rres[rkeys[j]]["atoms"]["CA"] for i, j in kept])
        R, qm, pm = kabsch(Q, P); rmsd = float(np.sqrt((np.linalg.norm(apply(Q, R, qm, pm) - P, axis=1)**2).mean()))
        npair = len(kept)
        res = {k: {"aa": v["aa"], "atoms": {a: apply(c[None, :], R, qm, pm)[0] for a, c in v["atoms"].items()}}
               for k, v in res.items()}
    vals = []
    for rad in RADII:
        q, n, mem = face_charge(res, keys, rad); vals.append((q, n))
    q14, n14, mem14 = face_charge(res, keys, 14)
    out.append((nm, acceptor, src, rmsd, npair, vals, mem14))
    print(f"{nm:16s} {acceptor:14s} RMSD {rmsd:4.2f} A / {npair:3d} CA   " +
          "  ".join(f"{r}A: {q:+5.1f}({n:3d})" for r, (q, n) in zip(RADII, vals)))
    print(f"{'':16s} charged residues within 14 A: {', '.join(mem14)}")

fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(12, 4.6))
cols = {"cytochrome b5": "#1f4e79", "coenzyme Q6": "#c00000", "unknown": "#e08a00"}
for nm, acceptor, src, rmsd, npair, vals, _ in out:
    axes[0].plot(RADII, [v[0] for v in vals], "o-", lw=2, ms=6, color=cols[acceptor],
                 ls="--" if nm == "Aim33" else "-", label=f"{nm} ({acceptor})")
axes[0].axhline(0, color="k", lw=.8)
axes[0].set_xlabel("radius from FAD isoalloxazine (A)"); axes[0].set_ylabel("net formal charge")
axes[0].legend(fontsize=8); axes[0].set_xticks(RADII)
axes[0].set_title("Charge on the FAD face scales with acceptor class", fontsize=10)

names = [o[0] for o in out]; q14 = [o[5][2][0] for o in out]
bars = axes[1].bar(range(len(out)), q14, color=[cols[o[1]] for o in out])
for i, v in enumerate(q14):
    axes[1].text(i, v + (0.12 if v >= 0 else -0.3), f"{v:+.1f}", ha="center", fontsize=9)
axes[1].set_xticks(range(len(out))); axes[1].set_xticklabels(names, rotation=20, ha="right", fontsize=9)
axes[1].axhline(0, color="k", lw=.8); axes[1].set_ylabel("net formal charge within 14 A")
axes[1].set_title("Blue = known cytochrome b5 reductase, red = quinone reductase,\norange = Aim33", fontsize=10)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
